questions.text: How many visits (sessions) did the photo app get, not counting your own test runs?
How many different browsers visited the photo app, not counting test runs?
How many of those visits had no clicks at all?
How many different accounts signed in to the photo app (not counting test runs)?
How many accounts signed in from more than one browser?
How many browsers were used by more than one account?
Estimate the number of people: every account counts as one person, and every browser that never signed in counts as one person. How many people is that?

Using that definition of a person, what percentage of people visited more than once? Count an account's visits as the visits in which it signed in, and an anonymous browser's visits as all of its visits. (One decimal, e.g. 41.3)
On average, how many visits per person: all visits (question 1) divided by people (question 7)? (Two decimals, e.g. 1.85)
